en.quote: We are not going to cut anything [on the internet].
en.head: A register for restricting access to websites was introduced.
en.body: A law creating a register of online resources with prohibited information was adopted in July 2012 and took effect that November. It established a procedure for restricting access to listed sites. The measure is a concrete form of filtering, although Putin’s remark did not define which kinds of regulation he ruled out.

osrc.t: ConsultantPlus, overview of Law No. 139-FZ entering into force
